name: academic-humanizer
title_zh: 改稿不动一个数字的学术写作编辑
tagline_zh: 论文、基金本子、rebuttal 都能用。专治 AI 腔和空话，保留你的语气和学术惯例。数字、结果、引用一律不碰。
tagline_en: For papers, grants, and rebuttals. Kills AI-speak and fluff, keeps your voice and scholarly norms. Never alters.
desc_en: Improve the clarity and voice of AI-assisted academic writing (papers, theses, rebuttals) and funding proposals (NSF Project Summary/Description, NIH Specific Aims): preserve scholarly conventions, match claims to evidence (and, for proposals, claims to feasibility), and match the author's own voice. It never changes a number, result, or citation, and it is not for evading AI-use disclosure. Use w
why_zh: 它先分清哪些是事实、哪些是修辞，只动后者。像懂行的同事，知道哪里该收敛、哪里该展开。
why_en: It separates facts from rhetoric and only edits the latter—like a sharp colleague who knows when to tighten and when to expand.
limit_zh: 只处理 AI 辅助写作的英文文本；不负责改写数据、补实验或重画图表。中文稿、纯人类写作、以及需要改动数字或引用的场景。
limit_en: English AI-assisted text only. Won't rework data, add experiments, or redraw figures. Useless for Chinese drafts, purely human prose, or any edit.
title_en: Academic editor that never touches a number
